info.title: Slant 3D V2 API
info.description: 3D Printing and manufacturing API that exists on top of the Slant 3D print farm. Allowing order creation for 3D Print on Demand applications, Prototyping, Bulk Ordering Parts, Price Estimations, and Internal Fulfillment operations. This spec is for automated tools and AI Agents.

x-agent-hints.maximum-platforms: 5 enabled platforms per account. Disabled platforms do not count: DELETE /platforms/{platformId} disables one and frees a slot, and PATCH /platforms/{platformId}/enable turns it back on if a slot is free.
x-agent-hints.pagination: page and limit parameters on requests.
x-agent-hints.usage: api/usage to review key usage for all user keys
x-agent-hints.file-upload: Use presigned URLs for direct browser upload. Confirm upload required for a file to be valid.
x-agent-hints.order-workflow: Upload files → Draft order → Process Order → Fulfillment Label Created Internally → Webhook Order Updates
x-agent-hints.webhooks: Configure webhook URLs on platforms for order status updates
x-agent-hints.platform-workflow: A Platform ID is required on most requests, as it is the organizational foundation of the API. Create or utilize one of the already created platforms and attach the ID to requests where it is required according to individual endpoint specifications.

servers.description: Production API server location for all requests

ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key authentication using Bearer token (sl_****)

Pagination.description: Returned alongside data on every paginated endpoint

count.description: Total records matching the request, across all pages

totalPages.description: How many pages the count works out to at the requested limit

limit.description: The page size that was applied

publicFileServiceId.description: Unique identifier for the file - use this for all file references

ownerId.description: Your application's user ID. This can be set for your internal file sorting

type.description: File type - currently only STL supported

metrics.description: New metrics field that is replacing STLMetrics. Includes more metric information and unit types

bodyCount.description: Automatically counted amount of bodies on the build plate. May not be 100% accurate

imageURL.description: OpenSCAD image generated from the file or manually updated

printTimeEstimate.description: Estimated time to print in minutes

supportRequired.description: Internally decided at upload or at time of print

supportVolumeEstimate.description: Estimated volume of the part in cubic centimeters

z.descriptions: z axis in millimeters. This is the internal vertical direction while printing

units.description: Units for metrics. Key is the field name with value as the unit type

STLMetrics.description: Automatically generated file analysis. Deprecated and being replaced by metrics. Kept for legacy support on applications.

price.description: Item price, as a fixed-point decimal string with two places. Sent as a string rather than a JSON number so the value stays exact; parse it with a decimal type, not a float.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for price. Currently always USD.

imageUrl.description: For STATIONERY items with custom image

status.description: DRAFT: not yet processed. SUBMITTED: paid and waiting to print. PRINTING: in production. SHIPPED: with the carrier. CANCELLED: cancelled before shipping

webhookURL.description: Webhook endpoint for order status updates

webhookSecret.description: Signing secret used as the HMAC-SHA256 key for this platform's webhooks. 32-256 characters, printable ASCII only (0x21-0x7E): spaces, tabs, line breaks and non-ASCII characters are rejected. The value is used exactly as submitted, so trim any whitespace picked up from an environment variable or config file before sending -- a stray leading space or trailing newline becomes part of the signing key and every signature check you run against our webhooks will fail. Returned in full on every platform read so it can be displayed in your dashboard.

enabled.description: Whether the platform is active. Set false by DELETE /platforms/{platformId} and back to true by PATCH /platforms/{platformId}/enable. Only enabled platforms count against the 5-platform cap, and GET /platforms returns enabled platforms only -- a disabled platform is still readable by its ID.

WebhookPayload.description: The body Slant3D POSTs to your webhookURL, and the body you send to POST /slant/webhook

platform_id.description: Your platform id. Must be a platform on your account

timestamp.description: Unix milliseconds as a string. Set for you when omitted

data.description: Event payload. Shape is validated against event_type: order events carry data.order, component events data.component, and filament.updated carries data.filaments with added, updated and removed arrays of public ids.

WebhookDeliveryResult.description: What your endpoint did with a delivery attempt

status.description: HTTP status your endpoint returned. Absent when no response arrived

body.description: Body your endpoint replied with, as sent

error.description: Present instead of status when the request failed outright, such as a DNS failure or a timeout

code.description: Underlying failure code where there is one

DeadWebhook.description: A webhook that failed to deliver. Retried automatically once a minute for up to 10 attempts, then held for a manual resend. Kept for 30 days. Catalog events (component.* and filament.updated) are broadcast to every platform and are never stored here, so they are neither retried nor resendable.

id.description: Pass to the single resend endpoint

webhookURL.description: URL of the last delivery attempt. Changing the platform's webhookURL sends later attempts to the new one

payload.description: The webhook body as it was sent. A resend delivers this unchanged, signed with a fresh timestamp

attempts.description: Delivery attempts so far, including the original

retryable.description: False when your endpoint rejected the webhook outright, which stops the automatic retries

lastStatus.description: HTTP status of the last attempt. Null when no response arrived

createdAt.description: When the first delivery failed. The 30 day window runs from here

succeededAt.description: When the webhook was eventually delivered

expired.description: True once past the 30 day window, after which it can no longer be resent

status.description: retrying is still in the automatic loop, failed is out of attempts and awaiting a manual resend, delivered landed, expired is past the 30 day window

DeadWebhookResendResult.description: Outcome of replaying one stored webhook

success.description: Whether your endpoint accepted it this time

status.description: HTTP status your endpoint returned. Null when no response arrived

expired.description: True when it was past the 30 day window and no attempt was made

alreadyDelivered.description: True when the webhook had already landed, so no attempt was made

attempted.description: Webhooks tried on this call, capped at 25

expired.description: How many were past the 30 day window and marked expired instead of sent

remaining.description: Still awaiting resend after this call. Call again while above zero

Component.description: A publicly available component. Optional fields are omitted when empty.

id.description: Pass this in the items array of an order to include the component

price.description: Price per unit, rounded to 2 decimal places

dimensions.description: Formatted X x Y x Z string

categoryId.description: ID of the component's category. Omitted if uncategorized

tags.description: Tag slugs attached to the component

Category.description: A component category. Categories form a tree up to 3 levels deep, and components are only assigned to leaf categories (ones with no subcategories).

slug.description: Unique URL-friendly version of the name

parentId.description: ID of the parent category, or null for a top-level category

profile.description: Material type. Always returned upper case. Filaments with any other material type are not exposed on the public API

color.description: Space separated color name. Always returned lower case

hexValue.description: Hex color code. Always a 6 digit lower case hex. Falls back to #a1a1a1 when the source value is missing or malformed

imageURL.description: Product image of the filament. Omitted from the response when no image exists for that filament

available.description: Filament availability. Filaments can go out of stock temporarily or indefinitely. Omitted from the response when availability is unknown

ServiceHealth.description: Result of the most recent health check for a single micro-service

healthy.description: False when the last check failed, timed out, or returned an unexpected status

lastCheckedAt.description: Timestamp of the last completed check. Null before the first check has run after a restart

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

get.description: Retrieve a specific file by its public ID with fresh download URL

patch.description: Reassign a file to a different owner in your application. Only the file creator (or an admin) can reassign a file, and ownerId is the only field this endpoint changes - any other property sent on the body is ignored. Reassigning a file to the owner it already has is a no-op and returns the file unchanged.

filePlaceholder.description: The exact filePlaceholder object returned from /files/direct-upload

data.description: Processed file with STL metrics and preview image

post.description: Retrieve multiple files by their public IDs in a single request

publicIds.description: Array of public file service IDs

get.description: Retrieve all enabled platforms associated with your account. Platforms disabled by DELETE /platforms/{platformId} are not included; fetch one by ID to read it.

post.description: Create a new platform for organizing your 3D printing projects

webhookURL.description: Webhook endpoint for order status updates

400.description: Validation failed -- the account already has 5 enabled platforms, the name is missing or over 100 characters, the description is over 500 characters, the url is missing, the webhookURL is not a reachable HTTPS endpoint, or the name, url or webhookURL duplicates another platform on the account (including a disabled one).

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific platform

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

webhookSecret.description: Set your own signing secret for this platform, used as the HMAC-SHA256 key for its webhooks. 32-256 characters, printable ASCII only (0x21-0x7E): spaces, tabs, line breaks and non-ASCII characters are rejected. The value is used exactly as submitted, so trim any whitespace picked up from an environment variable or config file before sending -- a stray leading space or trailing newline becomes part of the signing key and every signature check you run against our webhooks will fail. Replaces the existing secret immediately, with no overlap window where both are accepted, so deploy it to your verification code at the same time. Omit this field to keep the current secret, or use PATCH /platforms/{platformId}/webhook-secret to have one generated for you.

400.description: Validation failed -- for example a webhookSecret that is too short, too long, or contains whitespace or non-ASCII characters

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

delete.description: Disable a platform. This is a soft delete: the platform is marked enabled: false but is not removed, and its orders, files and webhook history are retained. A disabled platform stops appearing in GET /platforms and no longer counts against the 5 enabled-platform cap, so disabling one frees a slot for a new platform. It is still readable by ID and can be turned back on with PATCH /platforms/{platformId}/enable. Its name, url and webhookURL stay reserved against the duplicate checks so it can be re-enabled without colliding with a newer platform.

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

patch.description: Generate a new signing secret for this platform. Takes no request body. Rotation is immediate: the previous secret stops being used the moment this call returns and every webhook after that is signed with the new one, with no overlap window where both are accepted. Deploy the returned secret to your webhook verification code as soon as you rotate. To supply your own secret instead, send webhookSecret to PATCH /platforms/{platformId}.

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

patch.description: Re-enable a platform that was disabled by DELETE /platforms/{platformId}. Takes no request body. Re-enabling consumes an enabled-platform slot, so it fails with 400 if the account already has 5 enabled platforms -- disable another one first. Enabling a platform that is already enabled is also a 400.

400.description: The account already has 5 enabled platforms, or the platform is already enabled

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

post.description: Delivers a fixed dummy order.shipped payload to the platform's registered webhookURL, signed with that platform's secret. The payload carries dummy: true so your handler can ignore it. Nothing is stored and no order is affected. success on the envelope means the request was attempted - read data.success and data.response.status to see what your endpoint returned.

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

get.description: Every stored webhook for the platform inside the 30 day retention window, newest first. Includes ones that were eventually delivered, so use status to tell them apart.

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

post.description: Replays the platform's undelivered webhooks, oldest first, so your handler receives them in the order the events happened. Batched at 25 per call - keep calling while remaining is above zero. Webhooks past the 30 day window are marked expired instead of being sent. A manual resend is a single attempt and does not put a webhook back into the automatic retry loop.

404.description: Platform not found, or not owned by this API key

post.description: Replays one stored webhook by id. A single attempt: failing here does not return the webhook to the automatic retry loop. A webhook that already succeeded returns alreadyDelivered without being sent again.

404.description: Webhook not found on this platform, or platform not owned by this API key

post.description: Raise an event of your choosing against one of your own platforms. The payload is validated, then forwarded to that platform's webhookURL exactly as a real event would be, signed the same way. Delivery is asynchronous: a 200 means the payload passed validation and delivery was started, not that your endpoint accepted it. A failed delivery becomes a dead webhook. This endpoint sits outside the /api prefix.

400.description: Missing or invalid field on the webhook payload

404.description: platform_id is not a platform owned by this API key

Retrieve a single public component

404.description: No public component with that ID

get.description: Retrieve all available filament materials and colors. Optionally filter by material type and colour. Several values inside one parameter match as OR, separate parameters match as AND, so ?profile=PLA,PETG&color=red returns red filaments that are either PLA or PETG

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Material type to filter by. Not case sensitive. Repeat the parameter (?profile=PLA&profile=PETG) or comma separate the values (?profile=PLA,PETG) to pass several. Any value outside the enum rejects the whole request with a 400

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color to filter by. Matched as a partial, case insensitive search against the color field, so color=black also returns matte black. Repeat the parameter or comma separate the values to pass several

400.description: A requested profile is not publicly supported. The whole request is rejected, valid values passed in the same request are not applied

message.example: Unapproved Profile Passed in Filter Options. Current Public Supported List OPM,PLA,PETG

get.description: Retrieve all available stationery options
Get detailed usage statistics across all your API keys and platforms
Retrieve all API keys for your account

post.description: Generate a new API key for programmatic access

name.description: Human-readable name for the API key

post.description: Generate an STL Model file from OpenSCAD code. Provide the full OpenSCAD code as a string and the raw STL bytes are streamed back as application/sla, ready to write to disk or hand to the upload endpoint. Limited to 5 generations per hour with one generation in flight at a time.

scadCode.description: OpenSCAD code to convert to STL. The complete OpenSCAD source as a single string. Newlines and indentation are preserved, so a template literal or a file read off disk can be passed straight through.

200.description: STL file generated successfully. Read it with response.arrayBuffer() or response.blob(). Browser: new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer()). Node.js: Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer())

post.summary: Estimate print cost for a file
post.description: Get a price estimate for printing a file. Optionally specify a filament ID, otherwise defaults to PLA Black. Support is determined at the time of upload, not on this request: a file processed with supportRequired true is priced with supports enabled unless supports are turned off for that file internally.

options.description: Optional. Omit to price a single unit in PLA Black.

filamentId.description: Filament ID for the estimate. Defaults to PLA Black if not provided.

quantity.description: Number of prints to estimate. Defaults to 1.

subtotal.description: Print cost for the quantity requested in USD, before surcharges

total.description: Total estimated print cost in USD

pricePerUnit.description: Estimated cost of a single print in USD

quantity.description: Quantity the estimate was priced for

totalMaterial.description: Estimated material used for the quantity requested

estimatedPrintTime.description: Estimated print time for a single print

bodyChargeCost.description: Additional charge applied to multi body models in USD

oversizeSurcharge.description: Additional charge applied to oversized models in USD

get.description: Retrieve the most recent health check result for every micro-service behind the API. Checks run on a two minute interval, so polling faster than that returns the same payload. No authentication required and requests do not count against your rate limit.

data.description: Map of service name to its most recent health check result
